raw.query: WITH pool AS (SELECT pl.* FROM provenance.v_pool_latency pl JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND pl.is_current = true), measurements AS (SELECT source_path, engine, attn, n_images, patches, mean_ms, ci95_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE image_px = 448 AND n_images = 1 AND is_valid = true), exact_pair AS (SELECT * FROM measurements WHERE mean_ms = 11.360 AND ci95_ms = 0.006) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pool WHERE p50_ms = 11.360 OR p90_ms = 11.360 OR p99_ms = 11.360 OR max_ms = 11.360) AS current_pool_exact_value_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exact_pair) AS exact_measurement_pair_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements) AS measurement_denominator, (SELECT MIN(mean_ms) FROM measurements) AS min_mean_ms, (SELECT MAX(mean_ms) FROM measurements) AS max_mean_ms, (SELECT MIN(ci95_ms) FROM measurements) AS min_ci95_ms, (SELECT MAX(ci95_ms) FROM measurements) AS max_ci95_ms, (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY source_path, engine, attn) FROM measurements m WHERE mean_ms BETWEEN 11.0 AND 11.7) AS relevant_breakdown
